sites.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.key ... AND p.s IN (SELECT TOP {sample_limit} s FROM rdf_labels WHERE label = ?)
sites.reason: documented sampling (gql/engine.py:38-39 'Using TOP clause for sampling as per SC-002/SC-003 and FR-002'): not a unique key and not existence-only; for a label with more than sample_limit (1000) nodes the generated type's fields depend on which rows storage order returns, so the schema can differ between starts. No source settles whether a storage-order-dependent schema is acceptable. The same subquery joins rdf_props on s alone (graph mixing, F-1603).
